name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish public subsets, native equivalents, vendor HTTP equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery is not execution support. The exact legacy read tuple is connected-read-admitted and future mismatches fail closed; legacy general writers remain runtime-disabled. Three declaration snapshots cover 835 distinct methods. EasyEDA 3.2.209 offers tools for API reference, local discovery, status, bounded calculations/system/language/viewport/theme/toolbar-unit/system-library-ID and editor/shortcut observations, managed Allegro-file membership comparison, public catalog search/metadata, ordinary launch and a disposable project/PCB opening lifecycle with layer metadata, copper count and ten primitive-family projections. Offline managed-file readers prepare supplied bytes and extract bounded standalone library or project-archive metadata without EasyEDA, network access or imports. They validate container integrity, not geometry or dependencies. Catalog queries require explicit network confirmation, support footprint/symbol/device search, symbol and footprint name lookup, LCSC-code device lookup and known metadata lookup, and run without EasyEDA or SDK execution. Footprint-name and LCSC-code routes verify every returned candidate through fixed metadata endpoints under one bounded request budget. The seven public utility readers also accept a batch of unique methods sharing one admission sequence and ten-second deadline. All owners are captured before invocation; two complete ordered passes must match and any failure returns no partial batch. These are sequential observations, not an atomic snapshot. The SDK-resolved language reader can return a vendor fallback and does not verify provider success or private cached bus identity. After original ordinary process/Job termination, explicit release-closed awaits helper closure before freeing matching allocations; project and allocated diagnostic owners prevent release. Netlist comparison accepts exact managed ASCII Allegro files, compares footprint/designator and net/pin memberships only, and requires authenticated runtime admission; values and electrical correctness are outside that scope. Symbol name lookup verifies ordinary type from docType or two bounded native header records without parsing drawing geometry. Eight optional once-only observation stages retain the original receiver and compare two ordered samples. Primitive projections cover Line, Arc, Via, parentless String, Component, Pad, grouped Attribute, Dimension and Image. The selection/relations stage also captures ordered selected IDs and requested component child-pad lists, correlated with global Pad rows. Separate Pad and Image stages add native top/inner/bottom style groups, transformed M/L/A vector paths and opaque Picture references. Style groups are not physical-layer expansion, and image references do not verify asset bytes or availability. Arc observations retain centers, radii, endpoint radians and direction. Poured observations preserve existing serialized copper contours and parent associations in native ten-mil units without rebuilding or qualifying copper. Reader selection remains subject to the unchanged session command budget. Repeatable digest-bound queries filter published snapshots by exact IDs and supported fields, or return their captured selection and component-pad groups. Historical queries make no live call, adopt no owner and establish no current state. Observations do not prove complete model membership, reciprocal ownership, physical stackup, connectivity or saved contents. Opening can migrate, replay caches and automatically Save; original normal cleanup remains required. A separate disposable project-worker startup route captures original constructor callbacks, current wrapper and publisher relations, bracketed actor/local-Date observations, and original footprint-manager state through retained normal cleanup. Its once-only footprint-state stage checks the captured undefined user, client and maximum ticket without invoking GET_STR, copying or deleting a library. After footprint state, a separate source reader compares two native-cache source samples with the complete original checkpoint, preserving observed native order and refusing cache misses without parser replay or network fallback. Its implementation is a scoped native equivalent; connected source validation remains pending. A separate prepare-footprint-copy action uses only that original published source, retained opening and complete checkpoint, reserves eight requests and journals its result without dispatching a writer. The separate footprint-copy-preparation launch mounts source/producer/actor bindings, 53 dependency function qualifications and initialized UI/manager route observations with native channel-name qualification. The current-version actor collection has a separate fixed availability budget; historical actor packets keep their original timing contract. It preserves the original owner and durable phase records. Reciprocal bus peers, asynchronous completion, native clock transport, the whole writer lifecycle and saved content remain unproved. Direct asynchronous GET_STR and footprint copy/delete writers remain unavailable. It requires explicit debugger-pause acceptance and does not prove complete startup, native channel peers, contained destinations or server-clock provenance. A separate launch-sealed empty-baseline purpose retains the original managed SQL checkpoint, records intent before PCB navigation and joins fixed common data between empty raw-manager samples. It has fixed request, reply-class, aggregate-byte, polling and launch-time budgets, and cannot upgrade an existing startup owner. This sequential observation does not establish full model membership, startup completion or saved-state equality; connected validation remains pending. No general geometry writer, explicit Save, PCB-worker completion or recovery route is registered on209. Source/offline checks and installed snapshots are separate from connected validation. Older profiles retain their exact eligible metadata workflows and disposable validation routes; those proofs do not transfer to209. A distinct ratline-held-import purpose retains the complete source lease set and one original launch budget. After durable PCB navigation intent, it qualifies 29 PCB source phases, observes construction and holds the first child after seven qualified source phases. It also retains a bounded first-child native creation-stack observation with exact constructor comparison and explicit unqualified-evidence reasons. The PCB capture settles after the two parent events without waiting for callbacks that need the held child import to continue. It does not independently associate the JavaScript Worker object with its CDP target or continue the worker import. Callback/publication completion, complete startup and general writers remain unfinished; connected validation is pending. A separate fresh ratline-continuation purpose qualifies PCB and both worker source sequences, captures full PCB and first-worker observations, and permits one exact final project identity recheck. It retains separate command and helper-control budgets, original event ancestry, cleanup and durable intent. Exact Electron window hooks have bounded source/resume phases. Source-owned ordinary breakpoint transitions precede DOM ancestry queries at the initial window and first/final PCB sources, preserving original source ordinals and final resumes. Held-source ancestry accepts the exact original project root until native tab activation produces the observed PCB fragment, then refuses rollback. Original-owner inspection retains bounded raw ancestry replies and the first rejected capture reply with its fixed site, command and decoder stage, without enabling a retry. Original worker observations are sealed before their source-qualified retirement, retired realms lose command authority, and worker publication must match the PCB receipt and original target bindings. It cannot upgrade a held owner. Worker-to-CDP identity, callback and copper completion, complete baseline, saved/reopened persistence and writing remain unproved; connected validation is pending. No unrestricted JavaScript, arbitrary command, Save/Discard choice, force exit or blind retry is exposed. Historical journals cannot recreate ownership. Consult the skills and coverage inventory for exact scope.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
